{
  "description": "Gatus is a developer-oriented health dashboard and monitoring tool. It monitors endpoints via HTTP, ICMP, TCP, and DNS, evaluates conditions on responses, and triggers alerts through various providers (Slack, PagerDuty, Incident.io, etc.). It provides a web UI for status visualization and supports storage of endpoint results.",
  "version": "5.x",
  "capabilities": [
    {
      "name": "Alert Processing",
      "capability_id": "CAP.ALERT.EMERGENCY",
      "coverage": "partial",
      "evidence_status": "declared",
      "confidence": 0.6,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@4b84fa2d",
        "alerting/config.go@4b84fa2d"
      ],
      "notes": "Gatus supports alerting for service health failures (HTTP status codes, response times, etc.) via many providers. However, it is a passive monitoring tool that triggers alerts based on predefined conditions; it does not natively handle 'emergency' alert lifecycle management, geofence violations, or device-specific status warnings as described in the component purpose. It lacks specific emergency protocols or priority handling beyond basic alerting."
    },
    {
      "name": "Alert Acknowledgement",
      "capability_id": "CAP.ALERT.ACKNOWLEDGE",
      "coverage": "none",
      "evidence_status": "unknown",
      "confidence": 0.2,
      "evidence_refs": [],
      "notes": "No evidence of alert acknowledgement functionality (e.g., marking alerts as acknowledged, silencing, or resolving via user action) was found in the provided excerpts. Gatus focuses on sending notifications, not managing their lifecycle state via acknowledgement."
    },
    {
      "name": "Device Status Monitoring",
      "capability_id": "CAP.ALERT.DEVICE_STATUS",
      "coverage": "partial",
      "evidence_status": "inferred",
      "confidence": 0.5,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@4b84fa2d"
      ],
      "notes": "Gatus can monitor TCP and ICMP endpoints, which could be used to check if a device is reachable. However, it does not natively understand 'device status' (e.g., battery, CPU load, specific sensor data) unless exposed via an HTTP API that Gatus polls. It is not a dedicated IoT or device management system."
    },
    {
      "name": "Health Check Monitoring",
      "capability_id": null,
      "coverage": "full",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@4b84fa2d",
        "alerting/provider/incidentio/incidentio.go@4b84fa2d"
      ],
      "notes": "Core capability of Gatus: monitoring endpoints via HTTP, ICMP, TCP, DNS with condition evaluation."
    },
    {
      "name": "Alert Notification Dispatch",
      "capability_id": null,
      "coverage": "full",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@4b84fa2d",
        "alerting/config.go@4b84fa2d",
        "alerting/provider/incidentio/incidentio.go@4b84fa2d"
      ],
      "notes": "Gatus supports dispatching alerts to numerous providers including Slack, PagerDuty, Incident.io, Email, etc."
    },
    {
      "name": "Status Dashboard UI",
      "capability_id": null,
      "coverage": "full",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@4b84fa2d"
      ],
      "notes": "Gatus provides a web-based dashboard for visualizing the status of monitored endpoints."
    }
  ],
  "interfaces_detail": [
    {
      "name": "HTTP API",
      "protocol": "HTTPS",
      "direction": "bidirectional",
      "schema_ref": "",
      "evidence_status": "verified"
    },
    {
      "name": "Web UI",
      "protocol": "HTTPS",
      "direction": "in",
      "schema_ref": "",
      "evidence_status": "verified"
    }
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    "go 1.26.3",
    "fiber/v2 (web framework)",
    "prometheus/client_golang (metrics)",
    "sqlite (storage)",
    "various alerting provider SDKs (e.g., aws-sdk-go-v2, google.golang.org/api)"
  ],
  "runtime": [
    "Go",
    "Linux Container (scratch image)"
  ],
  "deployment_constraints": [
    "Requires configuration via YAML file (config.yaml)",
    "Runs as a single binary in a container",
    "No external database required (uses SQLite by default)"
  ],
  "maturity": "stable",
  "adaptation_hours_estimate": 40,
  "adaptation_confidence": "low",
  "adaptation_assumptions": [
    "Assumes significant custom code is needed to replace Gatus's native alerting with MQTT-based input/output.",
    "Assumes a new acknowledgement mechanism must be built from scratch as it is not present.",
    "Assumes device-specific status logic must be implemented via custom HTTP endpoints polled by Gatus or replaced entirely."
  ],
  "known_gaps": [
    "No native MQTT support for alert ingestion or dispatch.",
    "No alert acknowledgement workflow.",
    "No geofence violation detection.",
    "No device-specific status monitoring (only network reachability/HTTP health).",
    "No emergency alert priority handling."
  ],
  "risks": [
    "License: Apache 2.0 is permissive, but ensure compliance with all dependencies.",
    "Maintenance: Gatus is actively maintained, but adapting it to a specific defense architecture may require ongoing maintenance of custom patches.",
    "Security: Running in a container with SQLite is generally secure, but ensure config secrets (API tokens) are managed securely."
  ],
  "evidence": [
    {
      "claim": "Gatus is a health dashboard with alerting support for various providers.",
      "source_ref": "README.md@4b84fa2d",
      "verified": true
    },
    {
      "claim": "Alerting configuration supports multiple providers including Incident.io, Slack, PagerDuty, etc.",
      "source_ref": "alerting/config.go@4b84fa2d",
      "verified": true
    },
    {
      "claim": "Incident.io alert provider implementation exists with validation and sending logic.",
      "source_ref": "alerting/provider/incidentio/incidentio.go@4b84fa2d",
      "verified": true
    },
    {
      "claim": "Dockerfile builds a static Go binary for Linux.",
      "source_ref": "Dockerfile@4b84fa2d",
      "verified": true
    }
  ]
}
